threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of just 'the overground' when you hop on at Hackney Central. Locals know better!
Last night, a couple on the 133 bus was deep in a heated debate about which chicken shop does the best jerk. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh Döner and the sounds of laughter from the Kottbusser Tor park at midnight hit different. That's when I knew I belonged.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin will you find a techno party that starts at sunrise and ends with a spontaneous brunch in an abandoned factory. Pure magic!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they instinctively know to duck under the scaffolding on 16th to avoid the falling debris from some grand renovation.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy hop onto a Muni bus, karaoke mic in hand, belting out 'I Will Survive' to a captive audience. Only in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the Gaudí fanfare; they miss the real gems tucked away in the alleys, like that little art gallery near Carrer de Fraternitat.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their confusion at the local bar's 'tapas aquí, caña allí' ordering system, still hesitant to mix wine with seafood.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of 'the underground' and look at the bus maps like a lost tourist.
Caught a glimpse of a bloke fitting a saxophone under his jacket, then he hopped off at Tower Bridge. Bet that’s not his first gig on the night bus.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw three generations sharing a table at Kottbusser Tor, each with their own coffee ritual, I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain might you stumble upon a nightclub with a no cellphone policy, forcing you to actually engage with your surroundings—and the strangers next to you.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they know to pack a snack before a BART delay; that smoky Civic Center evacuation is just another Friday night inconvenience.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5 Fulton at Larkin this morning; the driver stopped to let a pigeon cross the road, and I swear it took its time. Just another day in the city.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just a pretty facade, but if they looked closer, they'd see the vibrant street art telling stories of local struggles.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by how they can't resist taking photos of every single building, even the ones the locals just pass by.
